column1: # Mount roots: the ONE list of cases every root validator is tested against
# (Rust validate::is_valid_root, the shared bash valid_root in bin/rclone-bisync,
# bin/rclone-backup and install.sh, the bar's Model.js). Every test runs these
# comments; an empty path field means the empty string.
# Rule: absolute; not "/"; every component non-empty and not "." or ".." (so no
# "//", no trailing "/"); no whitespace, control character, $ % \ " ' or `;
# not $HOME, not inside $HOME (so never ~/Cloud); at most 255 bytes.
# Encoding: the path must be valid UTF-8 and must not contain U+FFFD (the
# replacement character a lossy decoder puts in place of a bad byte), so a
# byte-reading reader and a text-decoding one reach the same verdict. The
# cases below hold raw non-UTF-8 bytes: read this file as bytes.
# The mount unit (systemd/rclone-mount@.service, via bin/rclone-mount) holds
# the same rule and refuses a root outside it.
